title: ACIS queued-versus-expanded membership set removal fast slice
mode: local implementation and generated in-memory regression
scope: Remove redundant processed-membership storage from rooted ACIS body traversal
Preserve breadth-first worklist order, projected graph links, cycle counts, and fail-closed budget behavior

changes.summary: Removed the expanded set and pop-time duplicate guard. The queued set admits each index once before it is appended to pending, so worklist entries cannot duplicate.

Tightened the generated owner-linked two-lump cycle regression to maxOutputItems=30, asserts equality with default reachable-node order and graph-link rows plus cycle count, and verifies 29 items refuses with ResourceLimit and clears output.

evidence.redGreen: The 30-item regression failed with the expanded-set guard present and passed after removing it.

limitations.reasonUncommitted: The shared worktree contains broad pre-existing modifications, including extensive changes to the same source and test files; staging or committing them together is unsafe.
